facts.value: Go to Professional Education Programmes, choose the MicroCred of your choice, click the Apply button, then ‘new user’. From there, create a username and password. Note these for later use. Upload required documents as stated under 'What to include with your application' on the entry requirement section of the programme webpage. Pay an application fee of €50 (electronic transfer) for up to three MicroCreds in one application. Finally, submit your application.
